auth.tagline: A text-based DAW. Sign in to open your projects and pick an engine.
auth.unreachable: The sign-in service is not answering. Signing in cannot help until it is back — every studio service verifies the session it mints.
engines.title: Select an engine
engines.latencyBreakdown: {network} ms of network + {audio} ms of audio interface
project.missingTitle: That project isn't in the repository
project.missingBody: The repository is here, but this project isn't: it was most likely renamed or removed since the media library last read the repository. Go back to Projects and open it again.
project.emptyWorkspace: This workspace holds no project yet. It was created here and nothing has been added to it — go back to Projects and add one.
project.librariesBody: Shared modules and chains live in a git repository, mounted into every workspace. This account has none yet, so nothing here could resolve a shared module. Add it at the top of the media library's Projects section, then open this again.
project.benchFetching: Building the rig and mounting the library on this machine…
share.goneBody: The snapshot it pointed at has been withdrawn by whoever shared it, or the address was mistyped. Nothing here can bring it back: ask them for a new link.
share.faultTitle: This share cannot be opened here
share.commentsHint: Anyone holding this link can read these. Whoever shared the project decides what to do with each one.
share.commentsEmpty: Nothing written yet. Say what you hear.
share.commentsFailed: The comments could not be loaded.
project.takenBody: {heldBy} has just opened it, and a project runs on one engine at a time — so this tab has stopped driving it. Nothing you had saved is lost. Open it again from Projects to take it back.
project.takenBodyAnon: It has just been opened somewhere else, and a project runs on one engine at a time — so this tab has stopped driving it. Nothing you had saved is lost. Open it again from Projects to take it back.
project.engineTakenBody: “{project}” has just been opened on the same engine, and an engine drives one project at a time — so this tab has stopped driving yours. Nothing you had saved is lost. Open this project again from Projects, or pick a different engine in Settings to keep both running.
project.idleBody: Nothing has happened here for {minutes} minutes, so the project was unloaded from the engine — which is free for somebody else again — and this tab let go of it. Your files have not moved; everything was already saved. Resume to reopen it where you left off.
modules.hint: The workspace's shared modules. Editing one changes it for every project here.
modules.empty: This workspace has no shared module library.
modules.filter: Filter by module or plugin name…
editorSettings.vimHint: Vim keybindings in the CUE editor — :w saves.
import.title: Import DAW project?
import.body: {name} is another DAW's project file, not a st0 file. Import it as a new project in this workspace?
filesGate.title: Can't reach this engine's files
filesGate.body: The file service on the selected engine didn't answer. It may be down, or this page's origin may not be allowed to call it.
filesGate.blockedTitle: This page isn't allowed to reach the engine
filesGate.blockedBody: The file service is running, but it refused this page's origin ({origin}). Approve it from the engine's menu-bar icon: Settings… ▸ st0 instances, then retry.
filesGate.downBody: Nothing answered at {base}. The engine's file service is probably stopped — start it from the menu-bar icon.
transport.recordMidi: Record MIDI (arm a MIDI track + play records)
transport.midiNone: No MIDI input — Web MIDI was refused or is unavailable here
status.engineStarting: the audio engine is starting up
commandBar.placeholder: command — Tab completes · e.g. create module, inspect graph, list vst, play
editorPanel.nothing: Nothing to edit — put the caret on a clip in the timeline, or open a sequence in the editor.
graph.selectTrack: Select a track in the timeline to see its chain.
docs.selectTrack: Select a track in the timeline or a module in the Chains graph to see its notes and to-dos.
mixer.noTracks: No tracks — add one with “new track:midi”.
home.unknownCommand: "{line}" is not a command on this screen
home.machineReadyHint: Projects are read, created and deleted on {machine}
home.noMachineHint: No engine machine is answering — projects are its folders, so the list waits for it
home.surfacesHint: Surfaces — the menu a second device opens, and installs
home.appsUnavailable: Other apps — pair a server in Settings to open them
repos.noMachineTitle: No engine machine is answering. Your projects are folders on that machine, so it is the one that says which exist.
repos.noMachineAside: Libraries and shares are set without it, below; the deploy key is in the {settings}.
repos.emptyMachine: Nothing on this machine. {new} creates one here, with no repository and nothing to set; {import} brings back one that exists — and for that one, remember to add the {key} at your git host first.
repos.openAndCreate: Open {name} and create a project in it (new tab)
repos.nameClash: two copies answer to the name “{name}” — these projects open by an address local to this machine
ws.newHint: Create a workspace on this machine
ws.newBody: Made on the machine, versioned by git, and with no remote repository. There is nothing to configure: the first project is chosen by opening it, and the repository is asked for the day you publish.
ws.importHint: Clone an existing repository onto this machine
ws.importBody: The repository is registered and then cloned onto the engine's machine. The deploy key has to be at your git host already.
ws.publishHint: Publish this workspace to a git repository
ws.publishBody: The repository has to exist and to be EMPTY. It becomes this workspace's remote, once and for all, and everything committed is pushed to it.
ws.removeBodyRepo: The folder and everything in it are deleted. The repository stays at its host ({origin}): what was pushed comes back by importing it again, what was not goes with the folder.
ws.removeBodyLocal: The folder and everything in it are deleted. This workspace has NO repository behind it: it exists on this machine alone, and nothing will bring it back.
shape.arrangementWhat: the timeline over the graph — one track, a synth, a pattern
shape.mixWhat: two decks, a crossfade, and an empty set list
shape.videoWhat: the timeline and the viewport — the arrangement, plus a picture lane
shape.liveWhat: no surface — an input, a fader, the output
shape.liveVideoWhat: the same rig, plus a webcam and the viewport it fills
project.newHint: Create a project in this repository
project.newBody: The project is created on the chosen machine, with the default settings, then committed — and pushed if the workspace has a repository.
project.deleteBody: The folder is removed from the repository on the machine, then the commit is pushed. Other machines lose it at their next refresh.
project.deleteKept: The contents stay in the repository's git history.
project.copyNone: no other workspace to copy into
project.copyBody: The folder is copied into the chosen workspace, then committed there — and pushed if that workspace has a repository. The original is untouched.
project.firstBody: This workspace is empty. A project is a folder in it, and the archetype decides what opens — you can add others beside it, and choose which one the engine plays.
machine.cloning: cloning the repository onto the machine…
machine.cloneSlow: the clone is taking more than ten minutes — it carries on on the machine, and the workspace will appear on its own when it is done
machine.cloneForgotten: the machine has forgotten this clone — try again
name.noDot: a name cannot start with a dot
commit.nothing: nothing to commit — is the folder ignored by git?
projects.noMachineBlocked: no engine machine is answering — a project is a folder on the machine, and it is the one that makes them
libs.noMachine: no machine is answering to record it
libs.title: Libraries
libs.missingBody: Shared modules and chains live in a git repository, mounted into every workspace as a submodule. {need}: without one, st0 refuses to open a project, because no {ref} reference would resolve. An {empty} repository will do — the catalogue already here is copied into it the first time a project opens.
libs.haveBody: The modules and chains every project of yours inherits. Mounted into each workspace as a submodule — what you commit there follows the repository, not the song.
libs.changeWarning: Workspaces already on a machine keep the old repository: their submodule still points at it, and it has to be changed there by hand.
ws.needLibraries: Add the libraries repository first — everything in a workspace resolves @st0/… through it
bench.title: Bench
bench.body: A live rig to try the library in: an input, a fader, the way out. Everything wired here is thrown away at the next open — what you keep, you keep in a module of the library.
bench.openHint: A live rig, rebuilt on every open
importDrop.title: Import this project
importDrop.body: {file} was dropped on {workspace}. It is translated into a project of its own — the file itself is not kept. What did not survive the translation is listed once it is done.
importDrop.working: Translating — a project with its audio takes a moment.
importDrop.refused: {what} is not a project this can import — drop a .dawproject. An Ableton set names its samples by path, so it is imported from the file tree instead.
shares.clipboardRefused: the clipboard refused — the link is on the row
shares.revokeBody:
The sound and the graph are erased from the server: the link answers “not found” for everyone who has it, at once and for good. The row stays here, dated.

Publishing the project again gives a NEW link — this one does not come back.
shares.title: Shares of “{label}”
shares.body: {frozen} copies of this project, published from st0 by {cmd}. They are listened to and watched with no account and no engine, and cannot be edited. A share {noexpiry}: it lives on the server until you take it down.
shares.none: No share. The link is made in st0, on the open project.
shares.linkGone: the link was erased with the files
comments.title: Comments on “{label}”
comments.body: Written by the people you gave the link to. They see all of them, with the state you give them here; they can change none of it. Nothing is erased: {resolved} and {ignored} are two ways of taking a comment out of the active list.
comments.emptyActive: Nothing to read. Comments land here as soon as somebody writes one.
hc.noWorkspaces: no workspace on this machine — start with: system repo add <uri>
hc.noMachine: no engine machine is answering — a project is a folder on the machine
hc.copyIntoProject: {to} is itself a project — the copy would never be listed in it
hc.deleteArmed: {path} — the folder will be recycled on the machine and the commit pushed; the contents stay in the git history. To do it: project delete confirm {path}
hc.nothingArmed: nothing has been named — project delete init {name} first
hc.notWhatWasArmed: that is not what was named ({what}) — nothing was deleted
hc.workspaceMade: + {workspace} — empty and with no repository; open it to make a project in it
hc.alreadyPublished: {name} has a repository already ({origin}) — publishing is for a workspace with none
hc.published: {name} published — the repository is in place and the workspace pushed
settings.title: Settings
settings.trayHint: The engine, the audio interface and this machine's own settings are in the tray's menu: they need a process on it. Here, what a browser can change.
menuEntity.shot: a shot on a picture lane
menuEntity.note: a note on the piano roll
cmdMenu.label: offer on a right-click on…
cmds.discardBody: The shortcuts, names and icons changed here will not be saved.
cmds.title: Commands
cmds.subtitle: their name, their icon, their shortcut and the order menus list them in — for you, in every browser of yours
cmds.keyHint: click then press a key — Esc cancels, ⌫ removes (⇧ passes through, ⌘/⌃/⌥ stay the browser's)
stems.title: stem separation
stems.selectLabel: the chain that splits a song into stems
stems.body: What “Separate the stems” and a deck's knobs use. A chain of a single offline step — the model it names has to be on this machine.
instrumental.title: instrumental
instrumental.selectLabel: the chain that gives a song without its voice
instrumental.none: — none: this machine makes no instrumental —
instrumental.body: What k7's “Make instrumental” asks for. The same model as above, over a chain whose module declares one output named instrumental.
settings.chains.title: Separation chains
settings.chains.hint: Which of your library's cold chains this machine separates a record with, and makes an instrumental with. One answer for the machine, whatever project is open.
settings.chains.noCold: Your libraries repository holds no cold chain — one whose single step is an offline module that separates. Write one under {dir}.
settings.chains.unavailable: This machine can't run it yet: {reason}
settings.chains.noMachine: No machine answers — start the engine on the machine these chains run on.
settings.commandsHint: Commands — rename, reorder, bind a key
master.alreadyFloor: nothing to bring down — the output is at the floor already
master.fixed: output at {db} dB ({trim} dB) — peak aimed at {target} dB
master.notADb: “{arg}” is not a level in dB
master.nothingToFix: nothing to catch — the last pass did not clip (give a level in dB to force it)
master.noMeter: no meter on this screen — give a level in dB
share.conflicted: Share / export — the repository has diverged, a pull needs a merge
rack.created: rack {ref} created — wire it from the graph
undo.processBody: {files} — the bounced file will be restored to what it was.
clip.noArmedTrack: no track armed — arm one with A / r
clip.onsetHint: click adds an onset · drag a mark to move it · click it to remove it
clip.warpHint: double-click drops a stretch point · drag its blue handle to say which beat it falls on · right-click it to remove it · the grey lines are the onsets, for reference
clip.trimHint: moves the event's window — the audio is untouched
clip.countingIn: counting in — the take starts after
clip.noTake: no take — start the transport with recording armed
pl.noAudioRow: no row of this playlist has any audio
pl.wontPlay: this file does not play in this browser
pl.separateHint: Separate every song into drums / bass / other / vocals, so one can be taken out at the desk
pl.nothingToSeparate: no row of this playlist has audio to separate
pl.emptyBody: This playlist names no song. Search the library for one, or write the lines under {items} on the left — it is the same file.
pl.alreadySplit: already separated into stems — the preparation will skip it
pl.sidecarMissing: the sidecar declares this file and the folder has not got it
pl.catalogueHint: pl8 — the media library: that is where a song is dropped
pl.pairServer: Pair a server in Settings to drop a song
pl.footerHint: the rows play one after another; the songs are the library's
pl.noChainYet: This machine cannot separate yet. Choose the chain once in the settings, under I/O — or {cmd}.
pl.separateCost: Each song takes several minutes, one at a time. The ones already separated are skipped, and an interrupted separation picks up where it was — starting again costs nothing.
tool.pointer: arrow — grab, frame, put the caret down
tool.cut: blade — cut the event at the beat pointed at
tool.erase: eraser — take the event off the lane
tool.mute: mute — silence the event without taking it off
tool.cutAtHead: nothing to cut: the cut falls on {name}'s start
tool.cutAtTail: nothing to cut: the cut falls on {name}'s end
grid.clipboardHasEvents: the clipboard holds events, not notes
grid.nothingToPaste: nothing to paste here — it all falls off the keyboard
grid.nothingToDelete: nothing to delete — the caret is on no note
seq.selection: selection: {steps} steps × {lanes} sound{s} — ⇧L loops it · v cancels
seq.hint: click lays one down / takes it off · drag sets the velocity · ctrl+drag moves · ⇧wheel nudges by a hundredth of a step
seq.offRack: off the rack — no sound answers to this note
seq.cellHit: {symbol} · beat {beat}{nudge} · vel {vel} — drag sets the velocity, ⇧wheel nudges, ctrl+drag moves, click removes
mode.sequencerHint: one step per cell, one row per sound of the rack downstream
mode.rollHint: for what a grid cannot say — velocities, off the grid, notes the rack does not name
mode.trackerHint: the file's notes as text — the arrows move, the keys type
mode.switchHint: change the view on these notes
metro.floorHint: the lowest is {min}% — for silence, click the metronome
seq.doubleHint: ×2 — the sequence twice as long, played twice
pls.brokenFile: this file does not parse — open the text to repair it
pls.emptyRepo: This repository holds no playlist yet. They live in {dir}, at the root of the workspace — so versioned with your songs, and the same whichever project is open.
pls.notAPlaylist: does not read as a playlist
pls.emptyFile: empty file — the first change will write this template
pls.noFileYet: no file yet — the first change will create it
pls.addUnsupported: the way `items:` is written in this file is not a shape adding can extend — add the line by hand
pls.moveUnsupported: the way `items:` is written in this file is not a shape reordering can change — change the line by hand
pls.brokenYaml: the YAML does not parse — the list shows the last readable version
refs.title: Reference tracks
refs.empty: This repository holds no reference track yet. They live in {dir}, at the root of the workspace — the mixes you listen against, versioned with your songs and the same whichever project is open.
refs.cannotPlay: this browser cannot decode this file
k7.newReleaseBody: k7 does not know this song yet: it needs an artist and a title.
share.confirmTitle: Share a frozen version of this project?
share.confirmBody:
Anyone with the link will be able to listen to it and see the tracks, the chains and the modules' parameters — with no account. The names of tracks, markers and modules, and the text of the notes, are part of that.

The link stays valid until you revoke it, in Projects on pl8.
share.rendering: rendering the share… (the whole song, this takes a moment)
commit.title: Commit message
commit.body: Stages and pushes the whole repository.
commit.needsMessage: a commit says what it changes
commit.oneLine: one line only: the verb takes the rest of its own
share.diverged: the repository has diverged — a pull needs a merge by hand
share.sameSession: same engine, same session: what is done there is done here.
tl.toolPicked: {tool} — click an event · esc or a gives the arrow back
tl.rulerSeconds: ruler in seconds — click to go back to bars
tl.rulerBars: ruler in bars — click to read in seconds (the picture cuts at the clock)
ed.trashBody: It goes to the recycle bin: nothing is erased right away.
ext.noEngineBody: Surfaces live on the machine that holds the working copies: with no engine there is nothing to drive.
ext.noProject: A surface joins the project the engine is already holding. Open one in the editor and this list will fill.
meter.clipped: — it clipped during the last pass
meter.hint:
{reading}
song output — {level} dB (0 = unity, +{max} the top of the fader)
meter.fixHint: bring the song's output down, for a peak at {target} dB
mst.oneUnmapped: one of its components is not mapped
mst.someUnmapped: {n} of its components are not mapped
mst.severalModules: — a mastering desk normally describes just one.
mst.noneResolve: none of its controls resolves for now
srf.drawnByShell: A “{type}” surface is drawn by the shell, not here.
wave.listenHint: listen — the file's from/to window, at its own tempo
clipv.noSeqFile: no sequence file for “{seq}” — the tracker edits a file, not an event
clipv.needsGraph: the step grid needs the graph to know the rack downstream
extsrf.editorOnly: “{ui}” belongs to the editor, not to a surface.
qr.noAddress: this machine has no network address
qr.notDrawn: the code could not be drawn
ruler.position: position in the song — clicking puts the playhead there
srf.timelineElsewhere: A “timeline” surface is drawn by the shell, not here.
srf.viewportElsewhere: A “viewport” surface is drawn by the shell, not here.
srf.masteringElsewhere: A “mastering” surface is drawn by the shell, not here.
rb.samePad: two pads carry the same file: {file}
roll.select: drag frames · a note moves, stretches, is set
roll.create: drag draws a note — its pitch where you start, its length where you let go
roll.remove: clicking a note takes it off
cb.newNodeBody: The module, then the node's name — for example audio/reverb hall.
cb.noQuotes: no quotes: they would count as arguments
rb.title: new rack
rb.hint: drag samples onto the pads · click to listen · the names become the symbols
extsrf.surfacesAre: Surfaces are the files of {dir}; the address names one by its file name.
rb.nameShape: the name becomes a folder: letters, digits, _ and - only
ext.noOpenProject: No project open on the engine.
mod.fileHint: the module's own file — one save counts for every instance of it
vp.noPicture: This project has no picture yet. Add
project.renameBody: The folder is renamed on the machine, then committed — and pushed if the workspace has a repository. Everything in the project follows it; only its address changes.
project.renameWarning: A link to the old address stops answering, and so does an editor already open on it. If this machine is playing the project, the engine stops.
project.renameSame: that is the name it has already
